title: Adaptive Retrieval, Selective Answers: Evaluating Conformal Factuality in Agentic RAG
abstract: arXiv:2610.34872v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve factual grounding without guaranteeing that every generated claim is supported. Previous work has studied claim-level conformal factuality in single-stage RAG and, more recently, multi-hop RAG. We examine its behavior in agentic RAG, where a language-model policy adaptively issues follow-up retrieval queries or terminates retrieval before response generation. We retain the retrieval-based relevance-scoring formulation and post-generation conformal filtering and evaluate six model-dataset configurations: GPT-6 Luna and Llama 3.1 8B on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA. Each configuration uses 60 fixed questions, 100 seeded 30/30 calibration-test partitions, five conformal target levels, and a no-conformal-prediction baseline. translated_title: 自适应检索，选择性回答：评估智能体RAG中的保形事实性
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）可以在不保证每一条生成的声明都得到支持的情况下改善事实性依据。以往的工作研究了单阶段RAG中的声明级保形事实性，最近也扩展到了多跳RAG。我们研究了保形事实性在智能体RAG中的行为——在这种范式中，语言模型策略会自适应地决定是否发出后续检索查询，或在生成回答前终止检索。我们保留了基于检索的相关性评分方法和生成后的保形过滤机制，并评估了六种模型-数据集配置：GPT-6 Luna和Llama 3.1 8B在HotpotQA、Natural Questions和TriviaQA上的组合。每种配置使用60个固定问题、100个带随机种子的30/30校准-测试划分、五个保形目标水平，以及一个不使用保形预测的基线。在全部六种配置中，更高的目标水平伴随着更高的观测完全支持率，同时也降低了答案的可用性。在95%目标水平下，……
tldr: 该研究首次系统评估了保形事实性过滤在智能体RAG中的表现，发现更高的保形目标水平能提升回答的完全支持率，但代价是答案可用性的下降。
en_tdlr: This work provides the first systematic evaluation of conformal factuality in agentic RAG, showing that higher conformal target levels increase observed full-support rates at the cost of reduced answer availability.
